paite: Aw, TOUPA phat in la thak sa unla; leitung luah tengteng aw, TOUPA phat in la sa un.
heading: Pathian, Kumpipa Tungnungpen / (1 Kro 16.23-33)
english: Sing to Yahweh a new song! Sing to Yahweh, all the earth.

paite: TOUPA phat a la sa in, amin phat unla; niteng in ahotdamna thu theisak un.
english: Sing to Yahweh! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!

paite: Namte lak ah athupina gen unla, michih kua peuhmah kiang ah athillamdang hihte gen un.
english: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.

paite: TOUPA a thupi a, nakpitak a phat ding ahi ngal a; Pathian tengteng sang a kihtak ding ahi.
english: For Yahweh is great, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.

paite: Mipite pathiante milim ahi ua; TOUPA'N bel vante abawl ahi.
english: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but Yahweh made the heavens.

paite: Pahtawina leh thupina ama ah a-om ua, hatna leh kilawmna amun siangthou ah a-om uhi.
english: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

paite: Michih a chichihte aw, TOUPA kiang ah pia unla, TOUPA kiang ah thupina leh hatna pia un.
english: Ascribe to Yahweh, you families of nations, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.

paite: TOUPA kiang ah amin thupina pia unla, thillat ding tawi in ahuangsung intual ah hong pai un.
english: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.

paite: Aw, siangthou kilawmna silh in TOUPA bia unla; leitung luahte teng aw, ama ah ling un.
english: Worship Yahweh in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.

paite: Namte lak ah, kumpipa in TOUPA atu, chi un! Leitung mah leng alin theihlouhna ding in, hihkip in a-om hi; ama'n khentuam nei lou in michih vai ahawm ding hi.
english: Say among the nations, “Yahweh reigns.” The world is also established. It can’t be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.

paite: Vante kipaktak in om henla, lei leng nuamtak in om hen; tuipi leh asung a thil om tengteng lum honhon uhen;
english: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!

paite: Lou leh asung a om tengteng kipaktak in om henla; huai hun in gam a sing teng in nuam in la asa ding uh;
english: Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy

paite: TOUPA ma ah, amah ahong pai dek hi; lei vaihawm ding in ahong dek ngal a. Khovel diktak in vai ahawmsak ding a, michih thutak in vai ahawmsak ding hi.
english: before Yahweh; for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, the peoples with his truth.
